tables.name: bundles
tables.purpose: Stores each bundle's identity, mode (fixed or flexible), enabled state, and a system-managed health status that reflects whether all constituent variants are currently available.

columns.name: mode
columns.purpose: fixed=predefined set; flexible=customer picks from pool

tables.name: bundle_items
tables.purpose: Stores the variant-level products belonging to each bundle, including the last-observed availability of each variant so the system can react when Shopify signals a change.

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the bundle this item belongs to

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the specific Shopify product variant id

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the parent product of the variant

tables.name: bundle_tiers
tables.purpose: Stores each discount tier for a bundle, including the minimum item count that qualifies a customer and the discount rate, ordered by the merchant's chosen display sequence.

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the bundle this tier belongs to

tables.name: bundle_purchase_records
tables.purpose: Stores a record of every bundle that was present in a paid order, keyed by order external identifier and timestamp so duplicate webhook deliveries produce no duplicate rows.

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the paid order that contained this bundle

columns.name: variant_external_ids
columns.purpose: comma-separated list of variant ids selected at purchase time

columns.name: discount_rate_applied
columns.purpose: applied discount rate in basis points

columns.name: order_total
columns.purpose: order total in minor currency units

tables.name: bundle_health_events
tables.purpose: Logs every automated health change applied to a bundle so merchants can audit why a bundle changed state.

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

columns.name: affected_variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant whose availability triggered this change

admin.purpose: List bundles paginated, filterable by status.
Update a bundle's title, description, mode, or enabled flag.
Replace the item set of a bundle.
List discount tiers for a bundle.
Replace the tier list of a bundle.

widget.purpose: Fetch bundle config, tiers, and items for the widget.
Validate a selection and return the earned tier.
Add the validated selection to the cart with discount applied.
